about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport Si4 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport Si4 was the petrol variant in the pre-2019 Discovery Sport range, alongside the diesel eD4 and TD4 models. It uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine — a turbocharged unit shared across several Ford and Volvo models of the same era, as well as other Land Rover applications. The Si4 badge distinguished it from the diesel options in the range, and it was available throughout the L550 generation from its 2015 launch until the 2019 facelift, when the diesel-focused Si4 was discontinued and petrol variants were rebadged under the P-series naming convention. The Discovery Sport Si4 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. The Discovery Sport Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted from 2015 to 2019 across the L550 generation. How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport Si4 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery Sport Si4? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine specification before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild Ford EcoBoost Discovery Sport Si4 engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every Discovery Sport Si4 rebuild. Do you supply used Discovery Sport Si4 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Discovery Sport Si4 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Discovery Sport Si4 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport Si4 ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery Sport Si4 from 2023 to present. The Ford EcoBoost features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost rebuild.
